items.title: Customer Success Manager, Public Sector (National Security)
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role As a Customer Success Manager on Anthropic's Public Sector team, you will be the post-sales trusted advisor helping national security customers realize the value of Claude and turn their investment into mission impact. You'll combine your customer success expertise with technical fluency to drive adoption of Claude Code, the Claude API, and Claude for Government (C4G) on classified infrastructure delivered through a cleared cloud provider, while maintaining our high standards for safety, security, and discretion. Working closely with our Sales, Applied AI, Product, Engineering, and Policy teams, you'll guide customers from deployment through enablement, model migration, renewal, and expansion. You'll develop genuine partnerships with customers' AI leadership, platform and compute teams, security and accreditation officials, and mission operators—and with the cleared cloud providers and system integrators that deliver alongside us. Your understanding of their mission, how they accredit and govern capabilities on classified fabrics, and how they evidence value to oversight will help them deliver decision advantage. Drawing on both your national security expertise and technical knowledge, you'll serve as a strategic advisor throughout their journey with us—helping them navigate constraints that don't exist in commercial or federal civilian deployments: classified-fabric accreditation, fixed compute capacity, compartmentation, limited telemetry, and need-to-know discipline. Much of this work happens onsite, in the customer's spaces, on their systems. Your role focuses on driving consumption and adoption of Claude across mission workloads, standing up enablement and change management suited to a cleared, mission-driven workforce, identifying and hardening the workloads that matter most to the mission, and demonstrating value in unclassified terms that can leave the building and support renewal and expansion. The insights you gather will directly inform our research priorities, product roadmap, and national security strategy—making you a key voice in shaping how Anthropic builds and delivers AI systems for the most demanding missions. Key responsibilities: Partner with the account executive and Applied AI architect to deeply understand the customer's mission requirements and translate them into an account and success plan, ensuring alignment between mission objectives, the customer's investment, and technical implementation Serve as the primary post-sales advisor to the customer throughout their Claude adoption journey, from deployment through enablement, model migration, renewal, and expansion. You will need to build trusted relationships across the customer's senior stakeholders—AI leadership, platform and compute teams, security and accreditation officials, contracting, and mission operators—and coordinate internally across multiple teams and with cleared cloud providers to drive customer success Support customers building with Claude Code, the Claude API, and Claude for Government on classified infrastructure—managed configuration, capacity and throughput planning, and workload onboarding—with a working understanding of accreditation requirements (FedRAMP High, IL5/IL6, classified-fabric accreditation) Create and deliver compelling enablement and executive content tailored to different audiences. You will need to spread the gamut from hands-on Claude Code enablement for engineering teams (Train the Trainer, managed configuration as the "paved road," Center of Excellence development) up to mission-value conversations with senior agency leadership, in unclassified language that can leave the building Help the customer develop evaluation frameworks and measure adoption and value without direct telemetry—provider capacity reports, customer-run dashboards, workload registries, and agreed leading indicators—and guide model migration and release readiness: eval gates built from their workloads, staged cutovers off end-of-support models, and realistic expectations about what lands on their fabric and when Drive consumption and adoption: separate under-pacing from burst saturation of a fixed compute pool, smooth and onboard workloads before asking for capacity, discover new mission workloads across compartmented organizations, and document value realized in mission-outcome terms (decisions accelerated, coverage, timeliness, findings produced) Own Executive Business Reviews that function as discovery and alignment—leaving executives with sponsor commitments, mutual next steps, and a mission-outcome narrative that supports the renewal decision—and serve as the primary conduit between the customer, cleared cloud providers, and Anthropic Identify common adoption and integration patterns and hero workflows that demonstrate mission transformation, and contribute insights back to our Product, Engineering, Research, and Policy teams—while maintaining strict separation of classified and unclassified channels and escalating correctly (e.g., 'Claude cut a high-volume analytic triage queue from days to hours') Work onsite frequently at customer facilities for enablement, workshops, and relationship building, on the customer’s systems and within their security and need-to-know rules Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities, agentic and Claude Code implementation patterns, and national security AI policy You may be a good fit if you have: Due to U.S. Government contract requirements, this position requires U.S. citizenship and an active TS/SCI security clearance with a current full-scope polygraph (a TS/SCI with CI polygraph may be considered where crossover is supportable) Must have prior experience working with US national security (defense and/or intelligence) agencies —ideally at the level of AI leadership, platform, and compute teams rather than a single program office—and a working knowledge of how national security agencies accredit, budget, govern compute, and measure mission (including the difference between FedRAMP High, IL5/IL6, and classified-fabric accreditation, and the role of cleared cloud providers and system integrators) 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles such as Customer Success Manager, Technical Account Manager, Solutions Architect, or Consultant, with experience navigating complex stakeholder environments; able to work onsite at customer facilities in the National Capital Region 3-4 days per week Experience driving success with consumption-based products (tokens, throughput, capacity) as well as seat-based products, including measuring adoption and value when you cannot see usage directly Technical fluency with AI/ML concepts, API integration patterns, and agentic tooling such as Claude Code; familiarity with common LLM frameworks, tools, and evaluation approaches, and hands-on experience building something with an LLM API or coding agent, is a strong plus Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders, from engineering and platform teams to security and accreditation officials to senior national security leadership Judgment and discretion: never over-promises on dates, capabilities, or documentation; practices need-to-know as a reflex; keeps composure under political and competitive pressure; strategic mindset to identify mission transformation opportunities and translate them into actionable expansion plans Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities—advocating for customer needs across internal (Applied AI, Policy, Research, Security) and external (cleared cloud provider, system integrator, program office) stakeholders Passion for thinking creatively about how to use AI in a way that is safe and beneficial for the national security mission, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems A knack for bringing order to chaos and an enthusiastic 'roll up your sleeves' mentality—you're a true team player The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $265,000 — $350,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Executive Producer, Executive Communications
items.description: Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! Why this role? Cohere has a strong AI narrative, the most deployable product, and a CEO who co-authored the foundational paper of modern AI. The company is positioned to become the transatlantic leader in sovereign AI for enterprise and government, and needs a storytelling engine to deliver that story at scale. This role sits within the team that is building that engine. We're looking for an Executive Producer, Executive Communications to own and evolve Cohere’s narrative globally as we grow to become the transatlantic leader in sovereign AI. This is a rare opportunity to use video as the primary medium to share voices and tell stories of executives at one of the fastest growing companies in the most dynamic space in technology. In this cross functional role, you will partner directly with C-Suite and VP executives, helping to determine how we talk to customers, partners, and employees. The role takes Cohere's narrative—the through-line that connects sovereign AI, transatlantic growth, and the product story—and turns it into the content the world sees and shares. You will execute Cohere's strategic narrative through various forms of content including video, podcast, and in-house production. While the role flexes across formats, we see video as the primary and most effective medium. The Executive Producer has dual aims: to grow the personal thought leadership profiles of Cohere's senior voices on their own channels and to deliver Cohere's narrative to the market through company channels. As Executive Producer, Executive Communications you will: - Build and execute Cohere's strategic narrative across three storytelling surfaces: Executive Thought Leadership, Policy Storytelling, and Corporate Storytelling - Partner with the VP Global Communications on narrative architecture and translating Cohere's narrative into content strategy and execution across the aforementioned three storytelling surfaces - Audit and gap analyses across Cohere's senior voices including the co-founding team, CFO, Chief AI Officer, SVP Government Affairs, and various VPs supporting the business - Develop content playbooks for predictable inflection moments (regulatory milestones, product launches, customer wins, IPO milestones) to be launched on executive and company pages - Partner with Marketing to create content for company accounts - Stand up the production function including stage capture systems, content atomization workflows, and freelance crew networks - Build AI-enabled workflows using Cohere's own products (Command, North, Embed, Rerank) for transcript-to-asset pipelines, executive prep automation, and narrative consistency - Initiate executive stage content capture and distribution at major events with lean, scalable production - Conduct executive content audits and gap analyses across senior voices - Refine and systematize content production workflows with predictable cadences - Develop flagship thought leadership pieces and corporate storytelling output - Scale successful surfaces based on impact analysis and team capacity You may be a good fit if you: - Have 8-10 years of experience building executive and corporate narratives from ideation through execution, ideally within a fast-paced, high-growth tech or AI environment - Are adept are creating production workflows from scratch (stage capture systems, content atomization pipelines) - Have experience in the high-paced broadcast television environment - Have experience building trust and rapport with executives and senior leaders naturally - Are scrappy. You thrive in thinking “outside the box” and find joy in marrying a problem to its solution - Are highly organized and process-driven, with strong project management skills and a bias for action - Bring high levels of creativity to communications – in format, channel, and storytelling - Are comfortable navigating organizational dynamics and building strong relationships across all levels - Thrive in ambiguous, fast-moving environments and know how to ruthlessly prioritize Ideal Candidate Profile The successful candidate will have experience in strategic communications, content production, and executive storytelling, with the ability to build scalable systems and leverage AI tools. They should be comfortable navigating executive relationships, managing production workflows, and adapting content strategies based on performance data. Experience in tech/AI environments and familiarity with Cohere's product suite would be valuable assets. FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching. - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!) - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite. HOW AND WHERE WE WORK: - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon. - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events. - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city. - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly. If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply. We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12a6IrLdF3kI2nonKSr4tiFuz18rLQbaeYV-JM9L4o9Q/edit, and we will work together to meet your needs. We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider. Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an @cohere.com or @cw.cohere email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers https://cohere.com/careers page.

New models and capabilities launch often, the cost to serve keeps changing, and customer usage can scale fast. How we price and package the platform shapes both our revenue and how efficiently we turn compute into value for customers. We're looking for a senior Finance & Strategy leader to own the financial strategy for the Claude Platform and to design the business models that come next. You'll sit on the Product Finance team and work closely with product, engineering, inference, and go-to-market leaders. You'll shape how we price and package the API, how we structure commitments and service tiers, and how we monetize new products and capabilities as they launch. You'll also work with infrastructure and inference teams so pricing reflects what it costs to serve and how capacity shapes what we sell. This is a finance role that sits very close to product. You'll be part of product decisions as they're made, bringing the financial model, the tradeoffs, and a clear recommendation. You know consumption-based and infrastructure businesses well, and you're comfortable owning complex pricing decisions alongside senior leaders. items.title: Consumer Support Specialist
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM The Support team at Perplexity AI is the frontline of our user experience. We ensure that our AI-powered search and answer engine delivers real value to every user—from individual consumers to teams and organizations. Our team operates across 3-4 active support channels—email, in-app messaging, Slack, and community—and collaborates closely with Product, Engineering, Billing, and Growth to turn user feedback into product improvements. We’re a lean, fast-moving group at a startup that ships constantly, so everyone on the team wears multiple hats and contributes well beyond just resolving tickets. ABOUT THE ROLE Perplexity launches new features and products at a rapid pace—and this role sits at the center of that. We need a Consumer Support Specialist who combines excellent customer support instincts with real technical depth. You’ll handle high volumes of user inquiries across channels while also digging into product issues, using customer feedback to uncover problems, and providing solutions that improve the experience for everyone. This isn’t just ticket work. As new features and products ship, you’re the person who hears about it first from users—what’s working, what’s confusing, and what’s broken. You’ll use those interactions to surface insights that shape how launches land, identify issues before they scale, and provide clear solutions back to users. You’ll also build automations and improve workflows that make the team faster and smarter, so we can keep up with the pace of the product without sacrificing quality. You should be comfortable operating across multiple support channels and have experience standing up or optimizing multi-channel support operations—not just working in them, but thinking critically about how they’re structured, routed, and scaled. This role requires someone who can navigate ambiguity and fill in the gaps where processes don’t yet exist. You won’t always have a playbook—and that’s the point. We need someone who can define the path forward, not just follow one. You’re a strong, independent operator who doesn’t need to be told what to do next: - You see the gap—whether it’s a missing Help Center article, a broken workflow, or a pattern in user tickets—and you move to fix it - You’re self-motivated and take initiative, but you also know when to ask questions - You communicate effectively with the team—keeping people informed, surfacing blockers early, and making sure nothing falls through the cracks - We won’t hold your hand through this role, and we wouldn’t want to—because you’re the kind of person who thrives when given ownership and trust RESPONSIBILITIES - Handle a high volume of user inquiries across channels (email, chat, Slack, community) with speed, accuracy, and empathy for both consumer and business users. - Deliver excellent customer support—clear, thoughtful, and human—even under pressure and at scale - Triage and prioritize effectively to keep response and resolution times on target - Use customer feedback and support interactions as a primary source for uncovering product issues, UX confusion, and feature gaps—especially as new products and features launch - Investigate and troubleshoot product issues: reproduce problems, isolate root causes, provide users with solutions or workarounds, and document findings for Engineering - Guide users through technical troubleshooting: AI search, LLM behavior, account configuration - File well-documented bugs in Linear with enough context for Engineering to act immediately - Leverage AI tooling and automation (Intercom, scripts) to streamline operations, reduce repetitive work, and scale support quality - Write and maintain Help Center articles, internal SOPs, escalation playbooks, and troubleshooting guides - Communicate cross-functionally—surface user insights to Product and Engineering, escalate issues, close the loop, and keep teammates informed - Track support KPIs and propose data-driven process improvements REQUIREMENTS - 3+ years in customer support, user operations, or technical support—ideally at a SaaS or tech company - Proven ability to manage high ticket volumes while maintaining quality and empathy - Excellent customer-facing communication: clear, professional, and adaptable to different audiences - Technical aptitude: comfortable working through product issues, navigating technical questions independently, and learning new tools and systems quickly - Hands-on experience with AI tools and automation platforms (Intercom workflows, scripting) to improve operations - Familiarity with AI, LLMs, or search technologies - Strong internal communication—keeps their immediate team informed, writes crisp updates for immediate team and cross-functional partners (Product, Engineering, etc.), and ensures stakeholders stay in the loop on issues and progress - Self-motivated and proactive: manages own priorities, takes initiative, delivers without waiting for direction - Experience creating user-facing documentation (e.g., Help Center articles, FAQs, guides) as well as internal SOPs, templates, and playbooks - Experience with multi-channel support operations—not just working across channels, but helping stand up, optimize, or scale how support is structured and routed - Comfortable in a fast-paced, high-volume startup environment with shifting priorities NICE TO HAVE - Experience with support and operations tooling such as Intercom, Parahelp, Linear, Notion, or Stripe. - Familiarity with prompting techniques and LLM optimization - Basic web tech understanding (HTTP, REST APIs, JavaScript, HTML) - Data analysis tools (SQL, Looker, Snowflake) - Scripting or lightweight automation background (Google Apps Script, Python) - Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup WHO YOU ARE You’re the kind of person who: - Sees a gap and fills it before anyone asks - Thrives in high-volume environments and keeps quality high even when things move fast - Thinks creatively—you don’t just follow the playbook, you look for better ways to solve problems and aren’t afraid to try something new - Treats every user interaction as a chance to learn something about the product - Gets energized by building automations that save the team hours - Communicates with clarity—whether writing a Help Center article, filing a bug, or updating the team in Slack - Takes full ownership end-to-end: you don’t just escalate, you follow through WHY PERPLEXITY? Impact at Scale – Your work directly influences millions of users and shapes the future of AI-powered search. Velocity & Ownership – Ship improvements quickly in a culture that values curiosity, speed, and quality. Cutting-Edge Tech – Operate at the forefront of applied LLMs and help define how AI transforms customer support.

We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As a member of the US Talent Acquisition team focused on Research and technical hiring, you will be instrumental in building and scaling Mistral's US-based research and engineering teams from the ground up. Joining early means you'll help shape both our technical recruitment strategy and operations, partnering closely with Research leadership across Research Science, Research Engineering, and adjacent technical functions. Your work will directly influence Mistral's frontier-model ambitions by ensuring we find and engage exceptional researchers and engineers who will drive Mistral's growth in the US. In this role, you'll also foster a strong candidate experience and help establish technical recruiting best practices as we expand across the US. items.description: About the Role As Head of Finance - Data Centers, you will be the finance leader for OpenAI’s self-built data center efforts. You will partner with teams across infrastructure, real estate, energy, construction, procurement, and finance to turn proposed sites into sound investment decisions and funded projects. This role spans the full development lifecycle: evaluating opportunities, building investment cases, forecasting capital needs, managing construction budgets, and helping determine how projects should be financed. You will give leadership a clear view of project economics, funding requirements, and risks as we build data center capacity at scale. In this role, you will: - Lead financial evaluation of proposed data center and related power infrastructure projects, including site economics, development costs, capacity phasing, lifecycle costs, and key risks. - Build and own project-level models and capital expenditure forecasts that connect construction schedules, power delivery, equipment procurement, contingencies, and funding needs. - Establish capital budgets and financial controls for active builds. Track commitments, actual spending, change orders, and forecasts to completion; identify cost or schedule risks early. - Partner with development, engineering, energy, construction, and procurement leaders on decisions that affect cost, timing, and long-term performance. - Work with Treasury, Corporate Finance, Tax, and Legal to evaluate financing options, including project or construction debt, leases, joint ventures, and other partnership structures where appropriate. - Prepare investment recommendations and capital approval materials for senior leadership, translating complex project details into clear choices and tradeoffs. - Build a consistent portfolio view of project costs, cash requirements, milestones, and financial performance. Partner with Accounting and operations teams through project completion and handoff. You might thrive in this role if you have: - Prior experience as the finance leader for large-scale data center builds or major electric generation projects. You have directly owned investment analysis, capital budgets, and financial decisions through development and construction. - Prior experience in investment banking or private equity. This is a strong preferred part of the background for this role. - 10+ years of experience across strategic finance, infrastructure finance, project development, or related fields. - Strong command of project finance, capital project economics, capex and cash flow forecasting, budget management, and the financing structures used to develop large infrastructure assets. - Excellent financial modeling skills and the judgment to test assumptions, quantify uncertainty, and recommend a path forward. - Working knowledge of construction cost drivers and risks, including utility and power timelines, procurement, contracts, and change orders. - The ability to work closely with technical and construction teams while communicating clearly with senior finance and business leaders. - Strong track record of hiring, leading and developing high performing teams. items.title: Global Transportation Programs, Senior Manager
items.description: About the Team The Real Estate & Workplace (REW) team creates and operates the workplaces and services that help OpenAI employees do their best work. Within Workplace Experience, Transportation connects our global office network through programs designed around employee needs, local conditions, and operational excellence. About the Role As Global Transportation Program Sr. Manager, you will own the strategy, expansion, and day-to-day performance of OpenAI’s employee transportation programs. You will make it easier for employees to get to and between our workplaces through reliable, accessible, and cost-effective commuting options. We’re looking for a builder who has launched and scaled employee transportation programs across countries in a fast-growing organization. You will translate our global workplace expansion plans into a transportation roadmap, establishing the systems, vendor partnerships, and operating practices needed to support new markets and growing offices. You’ll balance global consistency with local needs, creating repeatable approaches that enable local teams to deliver reliable service as the company scales. Location and work model: San Francisco, CA based, with required travel up to 10% to our global offices. This role will be in office Monday - Wednesday, with the option to work from home Thursdays and Fridays. In this role, you will: - Own a global transportation expansion roadmap aligned with office openings, headcount growth, and changing commute demand. Prioritize investments, forecast capacity and costs, and lead launches from market assessment through operational readiness and ongoing service delivery. - Manage the global employee transportation portfolio across shuttles, parking, micromobility, transit and commuter benefits, and EV charging. Determine the right service mix for each market based on employee needs, local infrastructure, accessibility, and cost. - Build a scalable operating model across regions, including repeatable launch playbooks, clear global and local ownership, vendor standards, integrated tools and reporting, and training for local teams. Adapt programs to local infrastructure, regulations, and benefit practices without rebuilding the approach for every office. - Manage transportation vendors from sourcing and onboarding through service reviews, renewals, corrective action, and transitions, partnering with Strategic Sourcing and Legal on commercial terms. - Own program budgets, forecasts, invoice review, and business cases; use utilization and cost data to recommend where to invest, optimize, or retire services. - Partner with Workplace Operations, Real Estate, Facilities, Corporate Security, People/Benefits, Payroll, Finance, Legal, IT, and Internal Comms to clarify ownership and deliver integrated programs. - Work with Benefits, Payroll, and Legal to design and administer transit benefits, parking eligibility, subsidies, and reimbursement policies appropriate to each market. - Establish clear service levels, incident escalation, backup plans, and outage communications so employees can navigate disruptions safely and confidently. - Improve the end-to-end employee journey, including discovery, enrollment, booking, support, and feedback; build clear intake, tracking, and resolution processes with internal teams and vendors. - Measure service reliability, adoption, capacity utilization, employee satisfaction, accessibility, and cost effectiveness; turn findings into improvements and concise leadership recommendations. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have directly built and scaled employee transportation programs across multiple countries during significant organizational growth, with demonstrated results in new-market launches, service reliability, adoption, and cost management. - Bring hands-on experience across multiple transportation modes, including shuttles, parking, micromobility, and transit or commuter benefits, with the ability to manage an integrated portfolio. - Can turn ambiguous expansion needs into practical plans, budgets, operating standards, and clear decisions while staying close to daily service delivery. - Have managed complex vendor relationships and commercial performance, including service levels, budgets, procurement processes, and service recovery. - Use data to evaluate demand, service quality, utilization, and cost, and can explain tradeoffs clearly to employees, partners, and leaders. - Build effective partnerships across functions, regions, and external providers, and can drive decisions and accountability without relying on formal authority. - Apply sound judgment to safety, accessibility, local requirements, and employee data, bringing in the right specialists when needed. - Communicate clearly, act on feedback, and remain calm and accountable during service disruptions or changing priorities. - Experience with commute-management platforms, transportation demand management, sustainability measurement, or systems integrations is a plus. items.title: Scaled Enablement Programs Lead
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Anthropic's partners are often the first place an enterprise hears about Claude. The sellers and practitioners inside our cloud, system integrator, ISV and reseller partners are positioning Claude in thousands of conversations we will never be in, and how well they tell that story shapes how customers understand what Claude can do for them. Getting that many people ready, and keeping them ready as our products move, can't happen one partner at a time. We're looking for a Scaled Partner Enablement Programs Lead to build and run the programs that carry our go-to-market motions across the ecosystem. Some of these programs you'll build, including a partner train-the-trainer model and a repeatable way to take sales plays to market with partners. Others you'll inherit and make better, including our global partner webinar series and the enablement that prepares Anthropic's own field to sell alongside partners. All of them serve the same outcome, field readiness, meaning sellers on both sides of a deal understand Claude, can position it with confidence, and know how to win together. This role combines program leadership with program building. Your job is to make these programs repeatable and to build the operating rhythm that keeps them consistent across regions. You'll connect Product Marketing, Sales, Partner Programs, our partner-type enablement leads, and the Partner Training & Curriculum and Certification teams. Key responsibilities Build Anthropic's partner train-the-trainer model, packaging our most effective training so partners can deliver it to their own teams and extend our reach beyond what our own team can deliver directly Build a repeatable way to take focused GTM motions, such as sales plays and launches, to market with partners at scale, working with our partner-type enablement leads so each play reflects how that partner motion actually sells Manage our global scaled partner webinar series and evolve it into the primary channel for launch, product and program messaging to the ecosystem, so partner sellers hear one clear, current story about Claude Strengthen how we enable Anthropic's own field on partners, so our sellers understand the value partners bring, know how to co-sell, and show up alongside us to help these programs scale. This spans field training that lands each new motion, partner content in GTM onboarding, and a central, current home for partner resources Run the portfolio as one system, with a shared operating model, content intake and calendar, production standards, and global delivery across regions, time zones and languages Lead a team of contractors aligned to specific programs, and keep work coordinated across the many teams that contribute to them Track field readiness and define metrics that measure program effectiveness beyond attendance You may be a good fit if you have Built and scaled 1:many enablement programs for large partner sales and technical audiences at a technology company, across partner types such as SIs, cloud providers, ISVs or resellers Enabled a large internal sales organization on new GTM motions, including how to co-sell with external partners Taken sales plays or GTM motions to market through partners and measured their pipeline impact Built or run a train-the-trainer model that let partners deliver training consistently without you in the room Led programs through a team of contractors or vendors, delivering across multiple regions and languages Comfort operating where products and messaging change constantly and the underlying operating systems are still being established Experience using AI across your day-to-day workflows to extend your own scale and reach The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $270,000 — $310,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Social Media Manager, Community
items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. We are looking for a Social Media Manager, Community to act as the human extension of our brand across our key social platforms. This is a full-time, senior role for an experienced community professional who will bring a strategic point of view to how Robinhood shows up in social communities. You will balance an accessible, bold, and relatable brand voice with the rigorous compliance standards required in the financial services industry. This role owns community management, social-first storytelling and marketing support — it does not include responding to customer support inquiries on social, which is owned by our dedicated Social CX team. This role is equal parts community builder, listener, writer, and judgment call. You’ll know when to engage, when to elevate feedback, and when precision matters most. This role is based in our New York, NY, and Menlo Park, CA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Own our community management strategy: Serve as the in-house expert on community management — setting the strategy, tone, and playbooks for how Robinhood shows up across X, Reddit, TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram, and evolving that strategy as platforms, culture, and our audience shift. Own daily community operations: Manage day-to-day community engagement across X, Reddit, TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram — writing social posts, responses, moderating conversations, and keeping our audience active and connected. Speak the language of retail investors: Leverage a deep understanding of online finance communities—especially the unique culture, humor, and rapid pace of finance communities on social—to authentically engage with our audience. Act as the voice of the customer: Monitor overarching community sentiment, utilize social listening tools, and gather real-time feedback to deliver actionable insights to our product and marketing teams. Spearhead community activations: Ideate and execute community-first events, such as live AMAs, platform-specific Q&As, and surprise-and-delight moments for our most dedicated users. Bring a human, community voice to product marketing: Partner with Product Marketing on launches and campaigns for products that call for an authentic, human perspective — shaping social-native creative and messaging, pressure-testing concepts against how our community actually talks, and showing up as the credible, on-the-ground voice of the community throughout the campaign. Stay close to internet culture: Constantly monitor the algorithm, related trends and meme formats, FinTwit narratives, and rising stars to keep Robinhood’s community presence cutting-edge and highly relevant. Represent the Robinhood voice with strong judgment Act as a critical line of defense to ensure all community communications adhere to Robinhood’s Content Standards and strict financial regulations, ensuring information is always fair, balanced, and truthful. What you bring 5+ years of experience in social media or community management, preferably at a fast-paced consumer tech, fintech, or culturally relevant brand, with a track record of owning a channel or program end-to-end. Experience partnering with product marketing, brand, or campaign teams — you know how to translate a product story into content and moments that feel native and human on social, without losing the community voice. A native understanding of platform nuances (especially our priority channels: X TikTok, Reddit, and Instagram) and how different communities operate within them. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; you can seamlessly code-switch between drafting a formal legal brief for compliance and writing culturally relevant posts on X. Data-driven mindset with the ability to translate social metrics (sentiment, engagement rate, conversions) into actionable strategy. Ability to thrive in a highly regulated industry, balancing creative marketing with strict compliance and legal guardrails. What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds. Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not. Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $128,000 — $150,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $112,000 — $132,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $99,000 — $117,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.title: Total Rewards Lead (1 Year Contract)
items.location_text: London; Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
items.description: Fireblocks is the company bringing global finance onchain. Backed by over $1 billion in capital, we are the premier digital asset infrastructure provider trusted by thousands of industry-defining financial institutions, including banks, payment providers, fintechs, and global corporates such as BNY Mellon, BNP Paribas, ANZ Bank, Western Union, Stripe, and Revolut. Built for institutional scale and security, our enterprise-grade platform and network have powered over $14 trillion in digital asset transfers worldwide. Fireblocks is looking for a Global Total Rewards Lead to lead our compensation and benefits programs across every market we operate in. You'll be the subject-matter expert on global comp benchmarking and benefits, and the operational owner of our two annual review cycles: the full annual compensation review and a mid-year mini cycle. This is a hands-on, high-visibility role for someone who loves both the strategic and technical sides of Total Rewards - building comp philosophy and structures, while also being deeply fluent in the tools that power them. You'll work closely with People Operations, Talent Acquisition, Finance, and business leaders globally to ensure Fireblocks pays competitively, fairly, and in a way that supports our growth as a global tech company. What You'll Do Own the annual and mid-year review cycles end-to-end - timeline execution, calibration, budget modeling, manager enablement, communications, and post-cycle reporting for both the full annual comp review and the mid-year mini cycle. Manage global compensation architecture , including job leveling, global salary bands/ranges, market pricing, and pay equity analysis across all regions where Fireblocks operates. Serve as the internal expert on Radford , using it for market data benchmarking, offer/band validation, and comp analytics that inform both cycles and day-to-day hiring decisions. Serve as the internal expert on HiBob & Pave , managing comp and benefits workflows, data integrity, reporting, and cycle configuration within the HRIS. Design and manage global benefits programs , balancing consistency with local market competitiveness and statutory requirements across multiple countries. Partner with Talent Acquisition on offer approvals, competitive positioning, and market intelligence to support hiring in a competitive tech talent market. Partner with Finance on comp budgeting, forecasting, and headcount cost modeling tied to both review cycles. Build manager and employee-facing communications to ensure transparency and understanding of comp decisions and total rewards philosophy. Monitor pay equity and compliance across jurisdictions, staying current on evolving pay transparency legislation globally. Continuously benchmark and refine Fireblocks' total rewards philosophy to keep it competitive with the broader tech and fintech markets. What We're Looking For 5+ years of experience in Total Rewards / Compensation & Benefits , with direct ownership of full-cycle annual comp review. Must have tech industry experience - you understand tech company pay structures, equity compensation, and the competitive dynamics of hiring in tech. Hands-on expertise with Radford - you can run market analyses, build/validate bands, and use it as a core tool in your daily work, not just as a passive user. Hands-on expertise in HiBob & Pave - proven experience configuring, managing, and reporting through HiBob and Pave for comp and benefits processes. Deep understanding of global compensation bands and structures across multiple countries/regions. Strong knowledge of global benefits design , including navigating differences in statutory and market-standard benefits across geographies. Experience managing multiple review cycles per year (full annual + mid-year/off-cycle) is strongly preferred. Excellent stakeholder management skills - you'll work cross-functionally with TA, People Ops, Finance, and business leaders. Strong analytical and Excel/spreadsheet modeling skills; comfort with data at scale. High attention to detail, discretion, and sound judgment when handling sensitive compensation data. Ability to work in a fast-paced, global, high-growth environment. Logistics This role requires being in the office 3 days per week. This is a 1 year fixed-term contract position. Fireblocks' mission is to enable every business to easily and securely access digital assets and cryptocurrencies. In order to do that, we strongly believe our workforce should be as diverse as our clients, and this is why we embrace diversity and inclusion in all its forms. Please see our candidate privacy policy here .

items.title: Enterprise Field Marketer
items.description: About the Team The Enterprise Marketing team helps the world’s largest organizations understand, adopt, and scale AI responsibly. We partner closely with Sales, Solutions, Product Marketing, Customer Success, Events, and executive leadership to create programs that accelerate strategic customer growth and strengthen OpenAI’s position as the leader in enterprise AI. Within Enterprise Marketing, the Field Marketing team is responsible for translating business priorities into high-impact customer engagement motions across industries, regions, and strategic accounts. We build and run programs that create pipeline, accelerate opportunities, deepen executive relationships, and bring OpenAI’s latest innovations directly to enterprise decision-makers. About the Role As an Enterprise Field Marketer, you will be a growth partner to Enterprise Sales, owning field marketing programs that create pipeline, accelerate strategic opportunities, and deepen relationships with priority enterprise accounts. Your focus will attach to the business’s most important needs at any given time, whether that means an industry motion, a regional priority, a strategic account, an executive engagement, or a new company-wide growth opportunity. You will own the full program lifecycle: translating sales priorities into field plans, identifying the right accounts and moments, executing high-quality customer programs, driving follow-up with sellers, and measuring business impact. This is a hands-on role for someone who can move from territory strategy to tactical execution quickly, with strong commercial judgment and high accountability for outcomes. This role is based in San Francisco, CA or New York City. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance. Travel is expected for customer events, executive programs, industry conferences, and internal planning moments. In this role, you will: - Build and execute field marketing plans aligned to priority seller groups, strategic accounts, industries, and regions. - Partner closely with Sales leadership on account prioritization, territory planning, outreach strategy, pipeline goals, and follow-through. - Own the full lifecycle of field programs, from strategy and planning through execution, seller enablement, follow-up, and measurement. - Run high-impact customer programs including executive dinners, roundtables, forums, workshops, industry moments, roadshows, and third-party conference activations. - Turn marquee moments into measurable pipeline opportunities with clear target accounts, success metrics, seller ownership, and post-event conversion plans. - Collaborate with Product Marketing, Events, Comms, Marketing Operations, Solutions, Customer Success, Partnerships, and executive stakeholders to deliver compelling customer experiences. - Track performance, communicate business impact, and build repeatable playbooks that help field marketing scale across enterprise segments. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have 8+ years of experience in enterprise field marketing, ABM, regional marketing, sales enablement, or related B2B growth roles supporting complex sales motions. - Have a track record of creating measurable pipeline impact through field programs, executive engagement, account-based programs, or industry marketing. - Understand enterprise buying cycles, pipeline creation, stage progression, and how field marketing can influence seller productivity. - Have partnered closely with enterprise sellers and sales leadership on territory planning, account prioritization, QBRs, pipeline reviews, and follow-up. - Can operate across strategy and execution: you can shape the plan, manage stakeholders, and personally drive the details. - Are highly organized, commercially minded, resourceful, and comfortable making progress when inputs are incomplete. - Communicate clearly and can influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Product, and customer-facing teams. - Are energized by AI and excited to help enterprises turn new technology into measurable business value. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. In addition, job duties require access to secure and protected information technology systems and related data security obligations. items.title: Payroll Analyst
items.description: We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented US Payroll Specialist to oversee our end-to-end multi-state payroll operations. In this role, you will ensure accurate, timely, and compliant payroll processing for all US-based employees while managing internal payroll initiatives. The ideal candidate is a strategic problem-solver with deep expertise in US labor laws, taxation, and ADP+Workday payroll systems. You will: Full-Cycle Payroll Processing: Oversee the accurate and timely processing of multi-state bi-weekly and semi-monthly payrolls for over a thousand exempt and non-exempt employees across most of the USA. Compliance & Taxation: Ensure strict adherence to federal, state, and local tax laws, as well as FLSA regulations. Monitor regulatory changes and update internal systems accordingly. Year-End Processing: Manage year-end payroll activities, including W-2 and W-2c generation, fringe benefit reporting, and annual tax reconciliations. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with HR to ensure accurate data flow for onboarding, offboarding, benefits deductions, and compensation changes. Ability to work with Accounting to ensure accurate general ledger mapping, month-end close procedures, and payroll account reconciliations. System Administration & Optimization: Act as the primary subject matter expert for our payroll system (e.g., Workday, ADP). Identify bottlenecks, recommend process improvements, and lead system upgrades or implementations. Issue Resolution, Continuous Improvement & Auditing: Conduct regular audits of payroll data to identify and resolve discrepancies. Serve as the ultimate point of continuous improvement with AI and other methodologies to ensure Scale’s payroll processes are best in class. Ideally you'd have: 5+ years of payroll experience. Strong organizational skills; the ability to get all priority tasks completed by the end of each day. Confidentiality and integrity. Accuracy under pressure and extreme attention to detail. Experience with ADP WorkforceNow and Workday. Bachelor’s degree. Technical proficiency. Nice to haves: Advanced AI technical skills. Excellent communication skills. Compensation packages at Scale for eligible roles include base salary, equity, and benefits. The range displayed on each job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the position and may be inclusive of several career levels at Scale; it will be determined during the interview process based on work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, interview performance, and relevant education or training. Scale employees in eligible roles are also granted equity based compensation, subject to Board of Director approval. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process, and confirm whether the hired role will be eligible for equity grant. You'll also receive benefits including, but not limited to: comprehensive health, dental and vision coverage, retirement benefits, a learning and development stipend, and generous PTO. Additionally, this role may be eligible for additional benefits such as a commuter stipend. Please reference the job posting's subtitle for where this position will be located. For pay transparency purposes, the base salary range for this full-time position in the locations of San Francisco, New York, Seattle is: $121,600 — $152,000 USD PLEASE NOTE: Our policy requires a 90-day waiting period before reconsidering candidates for the same role. This allows us to ensure a fair and thorough evaluation of all applicants. About Us: At Scale, our mission is to develop reliable AI systems for the world's most important decisions. Our products provide the high-quality data and full-stack technologies that power the world's leading models, and help enterprises and governments build, deploy, and oversee AI applications that deliver real impact. We work closely with industry leaders like Meta, Ernst & Young, Mayo Clinic, Time Inc., the Government of Qatar, and U.S. government agencies including the Army and Air Force. We are expanding our team to accelerate the development of AI applications. We believe that everyone should be able to bring their whole selves to work, which is why we are proud to be an inclusive and equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity or Veteran status. We are committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with physical and mental disabilities. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation in the application or recruiting process due to a disability, please contact us at accommodations@scale.com. Please see the United States Department of Labor's Know Your Rights poster for additional information. We comply with the United States Department of Labor's Pay Transparency provision . PLEASE NOTE: We collect, retain and use personal data for our professional business purposes, including notifying you of job opportunities that may be of interest and sharing with our affiliates. We limit the personal data we collect to that which we believe is appropriate and necessary to manage applicants’ needs, provide our services, and comply with applicable laws. Any information we collect in connection with your application will be treated in accordance with our internal policies and programs designed to protect personal data. Please see our privacy policy for additional information.

items.title: Applied Scientist (Internship in Paris or London)
items.description: ABOUT MISTRAL Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. THE ROLE Mistral AI is seeking Applied Scientist Interns and Research Engineer Interns based in Korea to join our team for six months in Paris or London, and then help build our new Seoul office as full-time team members. You will develop SOTA models across different modalities such as text, image, and speech. By developing novel methods and research ideas you will apply these models across a diverse set of use cases and domains. Working cross-functionally with both external and internal science, engineering, and product teams you will deliver high-impact AI solutions that turn the needle. Location and Work Authorization This internship is based in Paris or London for 6 months, with visa sponsorship and relocation support provided by Mistral. It is designed as a pathway into our Seoul office: on completion, successful interns will be offered a full-time role in Seoul. Candidates must be based in Korea and eligible to work there after the internship. WHAT YOU WILL DO - Run pre-training, post-training and deploy state of the art models on clusters with thousands of GPUs. - Generate and curate data for pre-training and post-training, working on evaluations and making sure the model's performance beats expectations. - Develop the necessary tools and frameworks to facilitate data generation, model training, evaluation and deployment. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to tackle complex use cases using agents and retrieval pipelines. - Manage research projects and communications with client research teams. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Fluent in English with excellent communication skills — at ease explaining complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. - Expert with PyTorch or JAX. - Not afraid of contributing to a big codebase; finds their way around independently with little guidance. - Writes clean, readable, high-performance, fault-tolerant Python code. - Doesn’t need roadmaps: moves independently and navigates uncertainty with confidence. - Low-ego, collaborative and eager to learn. - Track record of success through personal projects, professional projects or academia. NICE TO HAVE - Pursuing a PhD / Master in a relevant field (Mathematics, Physics, Machine Learning) — exceptional candidates from other backgrounds welcome. - Preferred duration: 6 months. Priority to candidates about to finalise their studies. - Research experience in agents, multimodal models, world models, robotics, diffusion models, cybersecurity, 3D understanding/generation, or time-series analysis. - Contributions to a large open-source or industry codebase. - Publications in top academic journals or conferences. - Enjoys improving existing code: typing, tests, CI pipelines. WHAT WE OFFER We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page https://app.notion.com/p/mistralai/Benefits-at-Mistral-36e6ba59a7fe836b93dd01737fcc27ef?source=copy_link. PRIVACY POLICY Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy https://legal.mistral.ai/terms/applicant-privacy-policy.

items.title: Engineering Manager – Growth Foundations
items.description: BUILDING THE FUTURE OF OPEN FINANCE Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system. Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page https://www.kraken.com/culture to understand what drives us and how we work. THE TEAM Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients. The Growth Foundations team builds the AI-native Growth Engine, enabling Growth teams across the company. We design and ship powerful AI-driven systems, tools and automations, as well as own the core infrastructure of Growth tools such as our website, user communications and martech. It’s a team with direct influence on company growth, global reach, and user engagement at scale. Our products serve millions of users globally. THE ROLE As an Engineering Manager within Growth Foundations, you’ll lead and develop a team of engineers who deliver high-impact features, platforms, and tools that power our growth. You’ll ensure the team is aligned, supported, and set up to execute with excellence — turning complex challenges into simple, reliable solutions that reach users around the world. You will also stay hands-on and deliver production grade features personally every day. THE OPPORTUNITY - Lead, mentor, and support a cross-functional team of engineers delivering growth-critical systems and features - Collaborate daily with Product and Design to define scope, set priorities, and ensure seamless execution - Keep projects moving forward — maintaining clear expectations, realistic estimates, and transparent communication with stakeholders - Provide technical guidance and context to help engineers make sound architectural and implementation decisions - Foster a culture of accountability, trust, and learning — helping the team grow their impact and autonomy - Improve team processes, communication, and collaboration across time zones - Partner with other engineering leaders to ensure consistency and best practices across the broader Growth organization - Leverage AI tooling daily to boost personal and team productivity - Stay hands-on in the codebase, writing production-grade code and setting the bar for quality, reliability, and speed WHAT YOU BRING - Experience leading engineering teams and delivering high-quality results in a collaborative environment - Strong people leadership skills — you invest in coaching, clarity, and empowerment - Solid technical foundation, especially on the backend; you can engage in design discussions, code reviews, and help engineers make pragmatic decisions - Strong individual contributor background — you write production-grade code and lead by example - High proficiency in modern AI-driven development — you use AI daily to boost personal and team performance through automation - Familiarity with one or more modern programming languages (e.g. TypeScript, Rust, Go, Python, or similar) - A product mindset — you care about how your team’s work impacts users and moves key metrics - Clear communication and organizational skills, with the ability to align engineering efforts with business goals - Experience working in distributed, remote-first teams NICE TO HAVES - Experience with analytics, performance/paid marketing, experimentation, or growth tooling - Background in developer experience, SDKs, or internal platforms - Exposure to scaling teams or processes during high-growth phases HOW YOU LEAD - You lead by setting context, not control — empowering engineers to make decisions with clarity and confidence - You coach through curiosity, helping others grow their judgment and autonomy - You communicate transparently, ensuring alignment across engineering, product, and design - You model accountability and empathy, creating an environment of trust and shared purpose We know that great engineers come from many backgrounds. If you're excited about the mission but don't meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. HOW WE WORK We give engineers ownership and trust them to ship high-impact work with craftsmanship and accountability. We move quickly, experiment often, and learn continuously from data and user feedback. We build acquisition and engagement experiences that are fast, resilient, and measurable. We collaborate asynchronously across time zones, connected by clear communication and shared goals. Unless a specific application deadline is stated in the job posting, applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. Please note, applicants are permitted to redact or remove information on their resume that identifies age, date of birth, or dates of attendance at or graduation from an educational institution. We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories for employment on our team, assessing candidates in a manner consistent with the requirements of the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance. OUR COMMITMENT Payward is powered by people from around the world and we celebrate the diverse talents, backgrounds, contributions, and unique perspectives that everyone brings to the table. We hire based on merit, seeking out people with the right abilities, knowledge, and skills for the job. We encourage you to apply for roles where you don't fully meet the listed requirements, especially if you're passionate or knowledgeable about crypto. We may ask candidates to complete job-related skills or work-style assessments as part of our hiring process. These assessments evaluate competencies relevant to the role and are applied consistently across candidates for similar positions. Results are considered alongside experience and interviews, and are not the sole basis for any employment decision. As an equal opportunity employer, we don't tolerate discrimination or harassment of any kind, whether based on race, ethnicity, age, gender identity, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Stay connected Follow us on Twitter https://twitter.com/krakenfx Learn on the Kraken Blog https://blog.kraken.com/#:~:text=Enter%20your%20email%20address Connect on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/kraken-exchange/ Candidate Privacy Notice https://www.kraken.com/legal/candidate-privacy-notice

You enjoy working directly with designers and product managers, see building great products as a shared responsibility, and communicate effectively in written and verbal English across a globally distributed team. - Versatility and AI proficiency.
